visual_target: stylized-realistic small curly-coated dog, recognizable as Kelsi from the approved family reference
identity_locks: recognizable rounded muzzle and expressive eyes
pink collar/tag identity when base outfit/accessory is visible
do not convert Kelsi into a generic golden retriever or primitive dog rig

avoid: human accessory geometry stretched onto dog
style.goal: compact expressive family-game quadruped with readable curly coat volume and clean silhouette

game_scale.note: Provisional game-space target only. Tune against Kristen/John in the cabin scale gate; do not interpret as a real-world measurement.

geometry.coat_note: Use sculpted/groom-card hybrid or efficient groom shell treatment that reads as curls without excessive alpha overdraw.

textures.compression_target: KTX2/Basis where runtime packaging supports it

accessory_adaptation.cowboy_hat: dog-specific crown/brim fit on hatSocket with ear clearance; same design identity, not a scaled human hat
accessory_adaptation.aviators: dog-specific bridge/temple adaptation or brow strap system; must not float
accessory_adaptation.earrings: use small ear-charm versions on left/right ear charm sockets
accessory_adaptation.filter: face material/effect mask adapted to canine face, only when visually appropriate
